
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tcjiaan/p/19394178" title="发布于 2025-12-26 12:32">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【EF Core】将一个实体映射到多个表的正确方法</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>把一个实体类型映射到多个表，官方叫法是 Entity splitting，这个称呼有点难搞，要是翻译为“实体拆分”或“拆分实体”，你第一感觉会不会认为是把一个表拆分为多个实体的意思。可它的含义是正好相反。为了避免大伙伴们产生误解，老周直接叫它“一个实体映射到多个表”，虽然不言简，但很意赅。</p>
<p>把一个实体类对应到数据库中的多个表，本质上是啥呢？一对一，是不是？举个例子，看图。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202512/367389-20251224181433980-239332348.png" alt="image" width="627" height="94" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>恭喜你猜对了，正如上图所示，假设老周收了几个徒弟，上述三个表其实都是【学生】实体类拆开的。第一个表是学生的基础信息，第二个表是补充信息，第三个表是学生的联系方式。第二、三个表中的行必须与第一个表中的行一一对应。</p>
<p>基于这样的理解，咱们可以得出：第一个表有主键A，第二个表有个外键FA引用主键A，第三个表有个外键FB引用主键A。同时，考虑到第二、三个表中的数据是完全依赖第一个表的，所以，第二、三个表中可以把主键和外键设定为同一个列。说人话就是有一列既做当前表的主键，也做外键引用第一个表。这使得第二、三个表中每一条记录的主键列的值必须与第一个表中的主键列相同。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202512/367389-20251224182656212-1982434610.png" alt="image" width="635" height="79" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>下面咱们举个例子说明一下。假设有这样一个实体。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 宠物
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Pet
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键

    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 昵称
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> NickName { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">天外物种</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 体重
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>? Weight { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 体长
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>? Length { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 毛色

}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>于是我有个想法，把这个实体映射到一个表中好像太长，拆开为三个表多好。</p>
<p>1、基本信息。ID，名称，宠物类别；</p>
<p>2、基础特征。毛色，体长体重等；</p>
<p>3、额外信息。爱好，性格等。</p>
<h2>一、错误用法</h2>
<p>脑细胞活跃的大伙伴们可能想到了怎么做了，于是：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
{
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Pet&gt;(entity =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文本类型的配置一下长度，不然全是 MAX 也不划算</span>
        entity.Property(d =&gt; d.NickName).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        entity.Property(d </span>=&gt; d.Color).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        entity.Property(d </span>=&gt; d.Category).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        entity.Property(d </span>=&gt; d.Hobbies).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        entity.Property(d </span>=&gt; d.Temperament).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 给主键命个名</span>
        entity.HasKey(d =&gt; d.PetId).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_my_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        entity.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.PetId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.NickName).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Category).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cate</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
        entity.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet_chars</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(p </span>=&gt; p.PetId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(p </span>=&gt; p.Weight).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">weight</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(p </span>=&gt; p.Length).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">len</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(p </span>=&gt; p.Color).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fur_color</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
        entity.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet_other</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.PetId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Temperament).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tempera</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Hobbies).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hobbies</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置外键</span>
        entity.HasOne&lt;Pet&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
                 .WithOne()
                 .HasForeignKey</span>&lt;Pet&gt;(p =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> p.PetId)
                 .HasConstraintName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FK_petid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    });
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>映射了三个表，最后创建一个外键，指向主键——自己引用自己。代码看着挺合理，但运行会报错。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202512/367389-20251225115729246-664967891.png" alt="image" width="479" height="192" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>错误是在模型验证过程中发生的，即验证失败。该异常是在&nbsp;RelationalModelValidator 类的&nbsp;ValidatePropertyOverrides 方法中抛出的，咱们进去看看源代码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">virtual</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ValidatePropertyOverrides(
    IModel model,
    IDiagnosticsLogger</span>&lt;DbLoggerCategory.Model.Validation&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entityType <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.GetEntityTypes())
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> property <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> entityType.GetDeclaredProperties())
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> storeObjectOverrides =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RelationalPropertyOverrides.Get(property);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (storeObjectOverrides == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> storeObjectOverride <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeObjectOverrides)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (GetAllMappedStoreObjects(property, storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.StoreObjectType)
                    .Any(o </span>=&gt; o ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeObjectOverride.StoreObject))
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                }

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> storeObject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeObjectOverride.StoreObject;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (storeObject.StoreObjectType)
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.Table:
                        </span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InvalidOperationException(
</span></span></strong>                            <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">RelationalStrings.TableOverrideMismatch(
</span></span></strong>                                <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">entityType.DisplayName() </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.Name,
</span></span></strong>                                <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.DisplayName()));
</span></span></strong>                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.View:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InvalidOperationException(
                            RelationalStrings.ViewOverrideMismatch(
                                entityType.DisplayName() </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.Name,
                                storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.DisplayName()));
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.SqlQuery:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InvalidOperationException(
                            RelationalStrings.SqlQueryOverrideMismatch(
                                entityType.DisplayName() </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.Name,
                                storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.DisplayName()));
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.Function:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InvalidOperationException(
                            RelationalStrings.FunctionOverrideMismatch(
                                entityType.DisplayName() </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.Name,
                                storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.DisplayName()));
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.InsertStoredProcedure:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.DeleteStoredProcedure:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.UpdateStoredProcedure:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InvalidOperationException(
                            RelationalStrings.StoredProcedureOverrideMismatch(
                                entityType.DisplayName() </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.Name,
                                storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.DisplayName()));
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NotSupportedException(storeObject.StoreObjectType.ToString());
                }
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>上面源代码中高亮部分就是抛出异常的地方。有大伙伴会说：老周你这是瞎扯啊，把一个实体映射到多个表，在官方文档上就有，只要看过文档的都不会犯这个错误。老周为了介绍其背后的知识，所以故意虚构了这个故事嘛。</p>
<p>好了，咱们简单说说原因。这里有一个概念，叫做 Property Override。说人话就是实体属性到数据列的映射可以存在覆盖关系。通常，咱们通过 PropertyBuilder 配置的列名、列的数据类型等是调用扩展方法 HasColumnXXXXX，例如</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Pet&gt;(entity =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    entity.Property(c </span>=&gt; c.PetId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    ……
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>实际上它是在代表属性的元数据上直接添加名为&nbsp;Relational:ColumnName 的 Annotation（这个可以翻译为“注释”）。Annotations 本质上是一个以字符串为 key，以 object 为 value 的字典结构。EF Core 中许多元数据都是用 Annotation 的方式存储的。再比如，你在 EntityTypeBuilder 上调用 ToTable 扩展方法，所配置的数据表名称，是以&nbsp;Relational:TableName 的Key存入 Annotation 字典中的。就像这样</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Model:
  EntityType: Pet
    Properties:
      PetId (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) Required PK FK AfterSave:Throw ValueGenerated.OnAdd
        Annotations:
          <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Relational:ColumnName: pet_id</span>
          <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: IdentityColumn</span></strong>
      Category (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>) MaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        Annotations:
          <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">MaxLength: </span></strong></span><strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">15</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: None
      Color (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>) MaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        Annotations:
          MaxLength: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: None
      Hobbies (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>[]) Required MaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>) Element type: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Required
        Annotations:
          ElementType: Element type: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Required
          MaxLength: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: None
      Length (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        Annotations:
          SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: None
      NickName (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>) Required MaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        Annotations:
          MaxLength: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: None
      Temperament (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>) MaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        Annotations:
          MaxLength: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: None
      Weight (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        Annotations:
          SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: None
    Keys:
      PetId PK
        Annotations:
          Relational:Name: PK_my_pet
    Foreign keys:
      Pet {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PetId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>} -&gt; Pet {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PetId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} Unique Required Cascade
        Annotations:
          <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Relational:Name: FK_petid</span></strong>
    Annotations:
      Relational:FunctionName:
      Relational:Schema:
      Relational:SqlQuery:
      <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Relational:TableName: Pet</span></strong>
      Relational:ViewName:
      Relational:ViewSchema:
Annotations:
  ProductVersion: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Relational:MaxIdentifierLength: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">128</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy: IdentityColumn</span></pre>
</div>
<p>但是，在 ToTable 方法调用时，如果使用 TableBuilder 的 HasColumnName 方法所配置的列名，并不是保存到 key 为 Relational:ColumnName 的 Annotation 字典中的。咱们不妨验证一下。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
{
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Pet&gt;(entity =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        ……</span>

        <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">entity.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.PetId).<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.NickName).<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
            tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Category).<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cate</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
        });
        ……</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> TestContext context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获得设计时模型</span>
IDesignTimeModel dsmodelsvc = context.GetService&lt;IDesignTimeModel&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 枚举出每个实体，每个实体的属性中的 Annotations</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entity <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dsmodel.GetEntityTypes())

    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  {prop.Name}的注释：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        {

        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>运行的结果如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">实体：Pet
  PetId的注释：
    Relational:ColumnName</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pet_id
    Relational:RelationalOverrides</span>= Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.StoreObjectDictionary`<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Internal.RelationalPropertyOverrides]
    SqlServer:ValueGenerationStrategy</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IdentityColumn
  Category的注释：
    MaxLength</span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Relational:RelationalOverrides</span>= Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.StoreObjectDictionary`<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Internal.RelationalPropertyOverrides]
  Color的注释：
    MaxLength</span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Hobbies的注释：
    ElementType</span>= Element type: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Required
    MaxLength</span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ValueConverter</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ValueConverterType</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  …………</span></pre>
</div>
<p>有没有发现多了个 Key 为&nbsp;Relational:RelationalOverrides 的注释项？而且它是个&nbsp;StoreObjectDictionary 类型的字典。它的声明如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> StoreObjectDictionary&lt;T&gt; : Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.IReadOnlyStoreObjectDictionary&lt;T&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> T : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在这里，T 是&nbsp;RelationalPropertyOverrides 类，这个类在用途上不对外公开（位于 Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Internal 命名空间），看命名空间就知道这货是和元数据有关的。其中，这个类公开了&nbsp;SetColumnName 方法，设置的列名存放在&nbsp;_columnName 字段中。</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 51, 102, 1)">1、调用 EntityTypeBuilder 的 ToTable 扩展方法时，可得到&nbsp;TableBuilder；</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 51, 102, 1)">2、从&nbsp;TableBuilder 的&nbsp;Property 方法返回得到一个&nbsp;ColumnBuilder 对象；</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 51, 102, 1)">3、调用&nbsp;ColumnBuilder 对象的&nbsp;HasColumnName 方法，这个方法调用了上面&nbsp;RelationalPropertyOverrides 类的&nbsp;SetColumnName 方法。</span></p>
<p>所以，你每调用一次 ToTable 方法，并用 TableBuilder 对象配置一次列名，那么&nbsp;StoreObjectDictionary 字典里就会多一个&nbsp;RelationalPropertyOverrides 元素。</p>
<p>咱们继续实验，把前面的代码改一下，专门打印 RelationalOverrides 注释的内容。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#pragma</span> warning disable EF1001

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WTF;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Program
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> Main(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] args)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> TestContext context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获得设计时模型</span>
        IDesignTimeModel dsmodelsvc = context.GetService&lt;IDesignTimeModel&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        IModel dsmodel </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dsmodelsvc.Model;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 枚举出每个实体</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entity <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dsmodel.GetEntityTypes())
        {
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">实体：{entity.DisplayName()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> prop <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> entity.GetProperties())
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> anno =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> prop.FindAnnotation(RelationalAnnotationNames.RelationalOverrides)</span>;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dics = <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">anno?.Value <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span> StoreObjectDictionary&lt;RelationalPropertyOverrides&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(dics != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dics.GetValues())
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    {item.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">DebugView.LongView</span>}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>先用&nbsp;FindAnnotation 方法查找出各个属性中的&nbsp;RelationalOverrides 注释，然后把注释的值转换为&nbsp;StoreObjectDictionary&lt;RelationalPropertyOverrides&gt; 字典，最后枚举字典中的项。</p>
<p>运行结果如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">实体：Pet
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: pet_id
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: cate
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: name</span></pre>
</div>
<p>如果调用 ToTable 方法映射三个表，RelationalOverrides 字典中的项就会增加。由于模型验证会导致异常，咱们写一个验证服务类，暂时忽略掉对属性覆盖的验证。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyModelValidator : RelationalModelValidator
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造函数的参数不用管，往基类传就是了，它是靠依赖注入取值的</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyModelValidator(
        ModelValidatorDependencies dependencies,
        RelationalModelValidatorDependencies relationalDependencies)
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(dependencies, relationalDependencies)
    {
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重写需要忽略的成员</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ValidatePropertyOverrides</span>(IModel model, IDiagnosticsLogger&lt;DbLoggerCategory.Model.Validation&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接返回，不执行基类的代码</span>
        <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span></span>        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">base.ValidatePropertyOverrides(model, logger);</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后在数据库上下文类的&nbsp;OnConfiguring 方法中替换默认服务。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
{
    optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">server=...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                            .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ReplaceService</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">&lt;IModelValidator, MyModelValidator&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">()</span>;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在实际开发中可不要这么干，这样容易破坏原有的验证逻辑。</p>
<p>这时候我们让 Pet 实体映射成三个表。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>entity.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.PetId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.NickName).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Category).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cate</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
});
entity.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet_chars</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    tb.Property(p </span>=&gt; p.PetId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(p </span>=&gt; p.Weight).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">weight</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(p </span>=&gt; p.Length).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">len</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(p </span>=&gt; p.Color).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fur_color</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
});
entity.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet_other</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.PetId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Temperament).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tempera</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Hobbies).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hobbies</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>最后输出的 RelationalOverrides 如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">实体：Pet
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: pet_id
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: _pid
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: _pid
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: cate
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: fur_color
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: hobbies
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: len
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: name
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: tempera
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: weight</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这东西有点复杂，不知道各位看懂了没有。其实就是你调用 ToTable 方法时，如果用 TableBuilder.Property(...).HasColumnName(...) 等方法配置一次，就会在 Overrides 字典里添加一条记录。但是，这个覆盖只针对属性和列之间的映射，而不针对表的。啥意思呢，咱们继补充一下代码，打印出实体中 TableName 注释的值。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> Main(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] args)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> TestContext context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获得设计时模型</span>
        IDesignTimeModel dsmodelsvc = context.GetService&lt;IDesignTimeModel&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        IModel dsmodel </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dsmodelsvc.Model;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 枚举出每个实体，每个实体的属性中的 Annotations</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entity <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dsmodel.GetEntityTypes())
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tbName = entity.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">FindAnnotation(RelationalAnnotationNames.TableName)?.Value <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            Console.Write($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">实体：{entity.DisplayName()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (tbName <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> or { Length: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }))
            {
                Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   表名：{0}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tbName);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
           ……
          }
     </span>|</pre>
</div>
<p>这里其实可以直接调用 GetTableName 方法获取表名的： entity.GetTableName()。</p>
<p>运行后输出的内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">实体：Pet   表名：<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">tb_pet_other</span>
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: pet_id
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: _pid
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: _pid
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: cate
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: fur_color
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: hobbies
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: len
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: name
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: tempera
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: weight</span></pre>
</div>
<p>咱们设置表名的顺序是 tb_pet -&gt; tb_chars -&gt; tb_other。而保存表名的就只有一个 Relational:TableName 的 key。也就是说，不管你调用多少次 ToTable 方法，不管你设置了多少个表名，Relational:TableName 键所对应的表名只能是一个——<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><strong>最后设置的那个</strong></span>，因为后面设置的值把旧值替换了。</p>
<p>这个东西不太好讲述，可能老周也讲得不清楚，所以有必总结一下，这个试验到底验证了什么。</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1)">1、ToTable 扩展方法设置的表名存到实体的&nbsp;Relational:TableName 注释中，永远只保留最后设置的表名。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1)">2、TableBuilder 所设置的列名，没有用 Relational:ColumnName 注释去保存，而是新加了一个 Relational:RelationalOverrids 注释，然后以字典形式存储所有覆盖内容，要注意的是，覆盖行为是基于属性，而不是实体的。比如上面例子中的 PetId 属性，它的第一个配置是映射到 tb_pet 表的 pet_id 列；第二个是映射到 tb_chars 表的 _pid 列；第三个是映射到 tb_other 表的 _pid 列。</span></p>
<p>那么，什么情况下会直接用 Relational:ColumnName 注释存储属性与列的映射呢？答案是调用 PropertyBuilder 的 HasColumnName 方法。就像这样：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Pet&gt;(entity =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    entity.Property(c </span>=&gt; c.PetId).<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
    ……
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>可见，这两处的 HasColumnName 方法是完全不一样的，再重复一遍，因为这个怕大伙伴们不好理解，老周只好多点F话。</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1)">1、PropertyBuilder.HasColumnName（通过 EntityTypeBuilder.Property(...)）直接在属性元数据中写入 Relational:ColumnName 注释。因此，这个 HasColumnName 不管调用多少次，保留都是最后一个设置的值，和 TableName 一样。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1)">2、ColumnBuilder.HasColumnName（通过 ToTable =&gt; TableBuilder.Property(...)）是在属性元数据上写入 Relational:RelationalOverrides 注释，并且其值是字典集合，你每调用一次 ToTable 它就会往集合里增加一个子项，即属性的列配置可以被覆盖很多次。</span></p>
<p>到了这里，有大伙伴可能有点悟了，这样不合理啊，实体与表之间的映射应该是唯一的。正是，所以我们开头那个示例就报错了啊，模型验证失败了呢。老周之所以绕了个大圈，现在才解释为啥抛异常，是担心大伙伴们看不懂，只好先说一下原理。我们现在回过头，看看&nbsp;ValidatePropertyOverrides 方法的源代码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">virtual</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ValidatePropertyOverrides(
    IModel model,
    IDiagnosticsLogger</span>&lt;DbLoggerCategory.Model.Validation&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 逐个实体检查</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entityType <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.GetEntityTypes())
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 实体中逐个属性检查</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> property <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> entityType.GetDeclaredProperties())
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这一行其实是返回 Relational:RelationalOverrides 注释的内容（字典）
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 集合中所有 Override 对象</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> storeObjectOverrides =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RelationalPropertyOverrides.Get(property);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (storeObjectOverrides == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span>;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果没有，说明列的配置没有被覆盖</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 遍历所有的覆盖配置</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> storeObjectOverride <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeObjectOverrides)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里实际上是根据当前属性，找到包含这个属性的实体
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 再根据这个实体，得到它映射的表名，这里读的是 Relational:TableName 注释
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 而现在我们用了三个 ToTable 方法，导致实体映射的表名是 tb_other
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 而 Overrides 集合中，这个属性可能对应了 tb_pet 表或 tb_chars 表
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Any(o =&gt; o == storeObjectOverride.StoreObject) 方法的调用就是用来比较 Overrides 中的表名和 TableName 注释中的表名是否相同</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (GetAllMappedStoreObjects(property, storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.StoreObjectType)
                    .Any(o </span>=&gt; o ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeObjectOverride.StoreObject))
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span>;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果存在任意一条是相同的，说明表名一致，就不会报错</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                }

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 代码走到这里，就说明上面的验证失败了，两处表名不一致
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType 只是表明出错的映射是面向数据表，还是表值函数，还是存储过程</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> storeObject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeObjectOverride.StoreObject;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (storeObject.StoreObjectType)
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.Table:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 示例程序报错的就是这里</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InvalidOperationException(
                            RelationalStrings.TableOverrideMismatch(
                                entityType.DisplayName() </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.Name,
                                storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.DisplayName()));
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.View:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InvalidOperationException(
                            RelationalStrings.ViewOverrideMismatch(
                                entityType.DisplayName() </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.Name,
                                storeObjectOverride.StoreObject.DisplayName()));
                    ……
                }
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>我们再看看前面实验代码输出的 overrides 列表。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>实体：Pet   表名：Relational:TableName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> tb_pet_other</span>
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: pet_id
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: _pid
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: _pid
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: cate
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: fur_color
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: hobbies
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: len
    Override: tb_pet ColumnName: name
    Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: tempera
    Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: weight<br></span></pre>
</div>
<p>根据源代码，首先是枚举实体，这里只有一个 Pet，然后枚举属性，那第一个就是 PetId 属性，接着枚举 PetId 属性的 Overrides，有三个：</p>
<p>1、映射 tb_pet 表的 pet_id 列；</p>
<p>2、映射 tb_chars 表的 _pid 列；</p>
<p>3、映射 tb_other 表的 _pid 列。</p>
<p>但是，GetAllMappedStoreObjects 方法是根据属性来创建 StoreObjectIdentifier 列表的，在本例中，这个 Identifire 就是 tb_other，这个 foreach 循环的意思就是所有 Override 的属性的表名都必须是 tb_other，如果有一个不是，就抛异常。foreach 循环第一个配置的是 tb_pet 表与 pet_id 列，然而现在的表名是 tb_other，所以，第一轮就匹配失败了，就 throw 了。</p>
<p>这样就保证了一个实体只能 Map 一个表。</p>
<h2>&nbsp;二、正确用法</h2>
<p>那么，EF Core 用什么办法把一个实体分散到多个表的？它很狡猾，一方面坚持一实体 Map 一表的原则，另一方面，它又提供一个叫“分片”（Fragment）的概念。实体映射的主表存储在 RelationalOverrides 注释中，而将其余分表存储在名为 Relational:MappingFragments 的注释中，同理，它也是一个字典集合——&nbsp;StoreObjectDictionary&lt;EntityTypeMappingFragment&gt;。一个分片由&nbsp;EntityTypeMappingFragment 类表示，对外暴露三个接口：IEntityTypeMappingFragment、IMutableEntityTypeMappingFragment 和&nbsp;IConventionEntityTypeMappingFragment。即</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EntityTypeMappingFragment :
    ConventionAnnotatable,
    IEntityTypeMappingFragment,
    IMutableEntityTypeMappingFragment,
    IConventionEntityTypeMappingFragment
{
      ……
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>配置分片表调用的是&nbsp;SplitToTable 扩展方法。和 TableBuilder 一样，属性与列的映射可以覆盖，并保存到 RelationalOverrides 注释中，只不过多了个 MappingFragments 注释。但多了这个分片，在模型验证时就不同了，GetAllMappedStoreObjects 方法中会循环遍历 Fragments 集合，并返回集合中所有表名。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (property.IsPrimaryKey())      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对于主键</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这个是对非分片的表</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> declaringStoreObject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectIdentifier.Create(property.DeclaringType, storeObjectType);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (declaringStoreObject != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> declaringStoreObject.Value;
    }
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表值函数，或数据来源于 SQL 查询，终止</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (storeObjectType <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.Function or StoreObjectType.SqlQuery)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里就针对分片，分片集合中所有表名都返回</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> fragment <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.DeclaringType.GetMappingFragments(storeObjectType))
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fragment.StoreObject;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前实体的派生类也要返回（TPT 或 TPC 映射方式）
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果是 TPH 映射，基类子类都存放在一个表中，只返回一个</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (property.DeclaringType <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IReadOnlyEntityType entityType)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> containingType <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> entityType.GetDerivedTypes())
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> storeObject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectIdentifier.Create(containingType, storeObjectType);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (storeObject != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeObject.Value;

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TPH 映射就是基类实体和它的派生类全存放在一个表中，并用一个专用列来标识类型，所以它不再需要返回其他表名，故中止</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (mappingStrategy ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RelationalAnnotationNames.TphMappingStrategy)
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>               <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对于非主键</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取当前属性中 TableName 注释所配置的表名，或默认表名</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> declaringStoreObject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectIdentifier.Create(property.DeclaringType, storeObjectType);
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表值函数和SQL查询的结果不需要多个表</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (storeObjectType <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectType.Function or StoreObjectType.SqlQuery)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (declaringStoreObject != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> declaringStoreObject.Value;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (declaringStoreObject != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 枚举所有分片</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> fragments =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> property.DeclaringType.GetMappingFragments(storeObjectType).ToList();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (fragments.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只要 Overrides 中的任意一列与分片中的表名匹配，都返回</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> overrides =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RelationalPropertyOverrides.Find(property, declaringStoreObject.Value);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (overrides != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> declaringStoreObject.Value;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> fragment <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fragments)
            {
                overrides </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RelationalPropertyOverrides.Find(property, fragment.StoreObject);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (overrides != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fragment.StoreObject;
                }
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 要是没有配置分片，说明只映射一个表，返回它</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> declaringStoreObject.Value;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (mappingStrategy !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RelationalAnnotationNames.TpcMappingStrategy)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (property.DeclaringType <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> not IReadOnlyEntityType entityType)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对于当前实体的派生类
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1、如果是TPH映射模式，那么全程只用一个表，所以只返回一个就够了
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2、TPC模式即每个派生类都要有一个表，所以全部返回</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tableFound = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queue = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Queue&lt;IReadOnlyEntityType&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    queue.Enqueue(entityType);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (queue.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tableFound)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 枚举直接派生类，不含间接子类
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TPC模式下，当前实体可能是抽象类</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> containingType <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> queue.Dequeue().GetDirectlyDerivedTypes())
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取派生类实体配置的表名</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> storeObject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StoreObjectIdentifier.Create(containingType, storeObjectType);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (storeObject != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> storeObject.Value;      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 至少返回一个</span>
                tableFound = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TPH 映射模式下只需要一个表就行了，所以 break</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (mappingStrategy ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RelationalAnnotationNames.TphMappingStrategy)
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                }
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果是 TPC 模式且找不到被映射的表，此时 containingType 可能是抽象类
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 把抽象类扔回队列中，下一轮循环继续撸它的派生类</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tableFound
                </span>|| mappingStrategy ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RelationalAnnotationNames.TpcMappingStrategy)
            {
                queue.Enqueue(containingType);
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>经过这么一处理，在&nbsp;ValidatePropertyOverrides 方法中，只要任意一个 Override 的列的表名和分片中的表名匹配，就验证成功。这么一搞，就做到了一个实体可以 Map 多个表了。</p>
<p>于是，数据库上下文类里面，OnModelCreating 方法的代码你应该知道怎么改了吧。</p>

<p>第一个表是主表，ToTable 保持不变；第二、三个表调用 SplitToTable 方法，列映射不需要改。</p>
<p>现在，把前面咱们替换的 IModelValidator 接口还原。在&nbsp;OnConfiguring 方法中删除&nbsp;ReplaceService 方法的调用。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

<p>重新运行示例，现在不会报错了。也可以用以下代码打印一下各个分片的信息。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Program
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> Main(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] args)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> TestContext context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

                Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   表名：{0}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,  tbName);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> prop <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> entity.GetProperties())
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印 overrides 的更简单方法，不用查找 RelationalOverrides 注释</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> overrides =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prop.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">GetOverrides</span></strong>();
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ovr <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> overrides)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  {ovr.ToDebugString()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                }
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印分片</span>
            Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n  分片：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> fragment <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> entity.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">GetMappingFragments</span></strong>())
            {
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    {fragment.ToDebugString()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>由于 EF 有相关的扩展方法，其实咱们不需要去手动查找注释的，如 GetTableName 方法获取表名，GetOverrides 方法获属性的覆盖配置，GetMappingFragments 方法获取分片列表。</p>
<p>再次运行示例，结果如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">实体：Pet   表名：tb_pet
  Override: tb_pet ColumnName: pet_id
  Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: _pid
  Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: _pid
  Override: tb_pet ColumnName: cate
  Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: fur_color
  Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: hobbies
  Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: len
  Override: tb_pet ColumnName: name
  Override: tb_pet_other ColumnName: tempera
  Override: tb_pet_chars ColumnName: weight

  分片：
    Fragment: tb_pet_chars
    Fragment: tb_pet_other</span></pre>
</div>
<p>咱们不妨获取一下创建数据表的 SQL 语句，检查一下是否正确。在 Main 方法结束之前放入以下代码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> sql =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.Database.GenerateCreateScript();
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n\n创建数据表SQL：\n{0}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, sql);</pre>
</div>
<p>生成的 SQL 语句如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cate</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">15</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_my_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></span></strong> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span>


<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet_chars</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">weight</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">real</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">len</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">fur_color</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">12</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_my_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></span></strong> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">FK_petid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FOREIGN</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">REFERENCES</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CASCADE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span>


<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet_other</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">hobbies</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">100</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tempera</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">30</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_my_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></span></strong> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">FK_petid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FOREIGN</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">_pid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">REFERENCES</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_pet</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">pet_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CASCADE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span></pre>
</div>
<p>所有表的主键名称都统一为咱们所配置的 PK_my_pet。只有主表 tb_pet 的主键使用 IDENTITY 生成标识，其他的分表不使用自动生成，而是与主表相同的主键值。同时，分表都有一个外键 FK_petid，引用主表的主键。这个外键对应的列同时也是当前分表的主键。</p>
<p>这样可以保证在数据操作中，三个表的状态能保持一致。</p>
<p>好了，今天就聊到这儿了。这次的内容有点复杂，可能不太好懂，老周也没法保证能讲明白。如果弄不懂也不要紧，会用 SplitToTable 来拆表就行。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
